title: Uber didn't beat Careem. It bought it.

beats.label: UBER × CAREEM · 2019
beats.text: Uber didn't beat Careem. It bought it.
A Dubai startup from 2012. The Middle East's first tech unicorn.
Here's how they made a giant pay up.

beats.label: CASH
beats.text: One. Cash. Most riders didn't have cards. So they took cash.

beats.label: CAPTAINS
beats.text: Two. Captains, not drivers. Local people, local support, local language.

beats.label: PATIENCE
beats.text: Three. Seven years building markets the giants treated as an afterthought.
You don't out-spend a giant. You out-understand the customer.
Send this to someone building for Pakistan.
